messages:
infra-sre-bot: :rotating_light: Pager P1: node-group-us-west-2 ephemeral storage pressure > 95% (sustained). Affected pods: llm-runtime-* (model-cache heavy), nginx-ingress-*. Triggered eviction cascade.
Maria G: seeing repeated pod evictions and a few crashed llm-runtime containers with CUDA init errors. Logs show 'failed to allocate kv cache'.
Chris T: copying logs — this started ~3m ago, spike in /var/tmp usage on nodes g4-*-pool.
Maria G: stacktrace snippet:
```
E 10:23:41 llm-runtime[pid:4123] - CUDA: out of memory during kv cache alloc
W 10:23:42 kubelet - eviction threshold reached: ephemeral-storage
I 10:23:43 llm-runtime - shutting down cleanly (signal 9?)
```
Lee R: confirmed. We have model-cache directories growing to multiple tens of GB per model due to shard rebuilds. Heavy logs + cache checkpoint writes.
Dana P: initial customer impact: a handful of requests saw 5xxs and increased latency. No broad 100% outage but degraded tail latency for hosted API customers.
Maria G: mitigation plan: 1) scale down llm-runtime replicas on affected nodes 2) cordon nodes with immediate evictions 3) purge stale model cache checkpoints 4) reduce logging level 5) trigger rolling restart to pick up cleanup.
Chris T: attempting quick purge: running on node g4-17:
```bash
ssh g4-17
sudo du -sh /var/tmp/model-cache/* | sort -h | tail -n 10
sudo rm -rf /var/tmp/model-cache/stale-checkpoint-*
```
Maria G: warning — rm will free disk but might cause cache misses and added load to other nodes. We should throttle.
infra-sre-bot: Action required: cordon node g4-17 (sre).
Lee R: cordoning g4-17 now and draining non-critical pods (keeping llm-serving around during graceful eviction):
```bash
kubectl cordon g4-17
kubectl drain g4-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --pod-selector='app!=llm-serving'
```
Chris T: reduced llm-runtime replicas via HPA override for responsible namespaces to 1 temporarily.
Dana P: notif sent to account-ops about degraded latency + potential 5xxs for customers on us-west-2. Adding to status page as 'degraded'.
Maria G: also lowered llm-serving log level to WARN and disabled verbose cache debug to stop write amplification. Patching Deployment live.
Lee R: CPU/IO graph: burst of disk writes correlates with model-loads at 10:20-10:27. Purge freed ~40GB on g4-17, IO back to normal.
Chris T: after purge, one node reported CUDA init error when restarted container: `cudaGetDevice(): unspecified launch failure` — likely from abrupt eviction during GPU memory allocation. Restart fixed it.
Maria G: steps for next hour: - keep 1-2 nodes cordoned in the group - increase ephemeral-storage ephemeralVolume size in ASG template for next deploy - enable model-cache eviction policy so checkpoint pruning happens when >70% usage - add alert on model-cache dir growth per node - run postmortem.
Dana P: customer impact summary (short): - Window: 10:20-10:40 UTC - Impact: elevated latencies and intermittent 5xx for a subset of hosted API traffic in us-west-2. - Mitigation: purged stale checkpoints on affected nodes, cordoned/drained nodes, lowered log level, scaled replicas. - Current status: degraded -> stable (monitoring).
infra-sre-bot: Pager update: oncall handoff planned in 25m. Maria G to hand off to next oncall.
Maria G: @oncall-bot I'm handing off: condition stabilized, logs show reduced writeback, freed ~120GB across 3 nodes. Please escalate if evictions reappear or model-load rate spikes >2x baseline.
oncall-bot: Acknowledged handoff. Next oncall: Lee R at 1758006123.
Chris T: leaving a few commands in runbook snippet for the follow-up playbook:
```bash
# check disk on nodes
kubectl get nodes -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name} {.status.allocatable.ephemeral-storage}\\n'
# list big folders
sudo du -ah /var/tmp | sort -rh | head -n 50
# safe prune
systemctl stop llm-runtime
rm -rf /var/tmp/model-cache/*-pruned-older-than-72h
systemctl start llm-runtime
```
Lee R: will take postmortem; collecting node-level iostats and kubelet eviction logs.
Dana P: I'll synthesize a short customer-facing blurb after the postmortem draft.
Maria G: thanks everyone. tagging :thumbsup: if you're good with handoff.
Chris T: :thumbsup:
Lee R: :thumbsup:
Dana P: :thumbsup:
infra-sre-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring.
